Established in 1769 by Eleazar Wheelock, it is the ninth-oldest institution of higher education in the United States and one of the nine colonial colleges chartered before the American Revolution.

Founded in 1865 by Ezra Cornell and Andrew Dickson White, the university was intended to teach and make contributions in all fields of knowledge—from the classics to the sciences, and from the theoretical to the applied.
Karl Jay Shapiro (November 10, 1913 – May 14, 2000) was an American poet.
Eliezer Wiesel (, "ʾĔlîʿezer Vîzel"; September 30, 1928 – July 2, 2016) was a Romanian-born American writer, professor, political activist, Nobel Laureate, and Holocaust survivor.
Denzel Hayes Washington Jr. (born December 28, 1954) is an American actor, director, and producer.

David Ian Hewlett (born 18 April 1968) is an English-Canadian actor, writer, director, and voice actor known for his role as Dr. Rodney McKay on the Canadian-American science fiction TV shows "Stargate SG-1", "Stargate Atlantis" and "Stargate Universe".

Pago Pago International Airport , also known as Tafuna Airport, is a public airport located 7 miles (11.3 km) southwest of the central business district of Pago Pago, in the village and plains of Tafuna on the island of Tutuila in American Samoa, an unincorporated territory of the United States.
Hoonah Airport is a state-owned public-use airport located one nautical mile (2 km) southeast of the central business district of Hoonah, Alaska.
Margaret Wilson (January 16, 1882 – October 6, 1973) was an American novelist.
She was awarded the 1924 Pulitzer Prize for "The Able McLaughlins".
Edna St. Vincent Millay (February 22, 1892 – October 19, 1950) was an American poet and playwright.
She received the Pulitzer Prize for Poetry in 1923, the third woman to win the award for poetry, and was also known for her feminist activism.
